payload.text: Session started in this project directory. Read `notebook.md` to see prior work. Reply with one short sentence: "What do you want to work on next?" No greeting, no emojis, no product branding. Galaxy credentials are configured -- call galaxy_connect() to establish the connection. Do NOT call other Galaxy tools until connected.
Find Galaxy history Santana_data and create a new copy of that history with which we will work. Rename it Santana2023Haiku

args.command:
# Get Galaxy API key from environment
API_KEY="${GALAXY_API_KEY}"
GALAXY_URL="https://usegalaxy.org"
SOURCE_HISTORY="bbd44e69cb8906b5de383eeb94e1df75"
TARGET_HISTORY="bbd44e69cb8906b5fb4f343d8e3c2259"

# Dataset IDs from the original history
DATASETS=(
  "f9cad7b01a472135729e19b8d6b0805b"
  "f9cad7b01a4721352286e3ad01efecc0"
  "f9cad7b01a4721352f3e64c6db61e054"
  "f9cad7b01a472135cffc97bdd41d117c"
  "f9cad7b01a4721357d455920ed83b365"
  "f9cad7b01a472135f1aefc030e018444"
  "f9cad7b01a4721359671a9b3b42f7699"
  "f9cad7b01a4721358d7200aaf890f826"
  "f9cad7b01a472135381f1c2781cb2a00"
  "f9cad7b01a4721350715a655adab59cb"
  "f9cad7b01a47213513a72aceabf93c6c"
  "f9cad7b01a47213502b9875db13bdff3"
)

# Copy each dataset
for i in "${!DATASETS[@]}"; do
  DATASET_ID="${DATASETS[$i]}"
  echo "Copying dataset $((i+1))/12: $DATASET_ID"
  curl -s -X POST "$GALAXY_URL/api/histories/$TARGET_HISTORY/contents/datasets/copy" \
    -H "x-api-key: $API_KEY" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d "{\"content_id\": \"$DATASET_ID\", \"source\": \"library\"}" > /dev/null && echo "  ✓ copied" || echo "  ✗ failed"
done

echo "Done. Verifying target history..."
curl -s "$GALAXY_URL/api/histories/$TARGET_HISTORY" \
  -H "x-api-key: $API_KEY" | grep -o '"count":[0-9]*'

args.command:
API_KEY="${GALAXY_API_KEY}"
GALAXY_URL="https://usegalaxy.org"
SOURCE_HISTORY="bbd44e69cb8906b5de383eeb94e1df75"
TARGET_HISTORY="bbd44e69cb8906b5fb4f343d8e3c2259"

# First, get the history dataset association IDs (hid) from source
echo "Fetching source history contents..."
curl -s "$GALAXY_URL/api/histories/$SOURCE_HISTORY/contents" \
  -H "x-api-key: $API_KEY" | jq -r '.[] | "\(.id)"' > /tmp/dataset_ids.txt

# Copy each dataset using the correct endpoint
while IFS= read -r HIST_DATASET_ID; do
  echo "Copying $HIST_DATASET_ID..."
  curl -s -X POST "$GALAXY_URL/api/histories/$TARGET_HISTORY/contents/datasets/copy" \
    -H "x-api-key: $API_KEY" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d "{\"content_id\": \"$HIST_DATASET_ID\", \"source\": \"hda\"}" | jq . > /dev/null 2>&1 && echo "  ✓" || echo "  ✗"
done < /tmp/dataset_ids.txt

echo "Verifying..."
curl -s "$GALAXY_URL/api/histories/$TARGET_HISTORY" \
  -H "x-api-key: $API_KEY" | jq '.count'
